blueprint.title: English Paper — GL Standard Style

sections.instructions: Read the story first. Take your time. Then answer the questions about it. Some questions point you to a line number. Go back and read that line again before you choose. There are five answers each time. If one feels hard, move on and come back.
Each line here has four parts. One part may have a spelling that is not right. Mark that part. If every part is fine, mark N. A worked example comes first — read it before you start.
Each line here has four parts. One part may be missing a punctuation mark, or have one that does not belong. Mark that part. If every part is fine, mark N.
Each sentence has a gap. Pick the word that fits the gap best. Read the whole sentence before you choose. The words around the gap tell you what kind of word it needs.

blueprint.notes: Authored FROM corpus evidence (SCP-E-1 as revised: the 56% SPaG share is GL-SPECIFIC, this track only). 52q/50min: one deep comprehension cluster plus spelling 9, punctuation 9, cloze 9; MC throughout; 4-segment+N slip-spotting, N genuinely keyed 1-2 per section. Mirror-pair design (SCP-E-4) applies to MOCK-pool pairs. Types are forward refs to an English registry that does not exist yet.
